title: Escape Room Kansas City
specs: You are prohibited from accessing this website if you are under thirteen (13) years of age
Online Reservations may not be made by minors. If you are under eighteen (18) years of age you may not use this website to make a reservation
Children ages 7-16 must be accompanied by an adult to participate

gap: Price per person or group not stated
blurb: Guests participate in escape room games that involve solving puzzles and cooperating with team members to escape within a time limit. Children ages 7-16 must be accompanied by an adult; children under 7 should not participate. The experience may include startling or tense elements and areas of the floor may become wet due to puzzles involving liquids.
extraNote: All bookings are final and Escape Room cannot give refunds for cancellations or no-shows · You should arrive 10-15 minutes before the game start time. Persons arriving after this time may be denied access to the game · Game participants may be required to agree to a participation agreement/waiver prior to game · If you are under the influence of alcohol or drugs you may be turned away without refund · The use of electronic devices, including but not limited to mobile phones, recording devices (visual and/or audio), tablets, and cameras is prohibited inside the rooms · If you must leave the room prior to finishing the experience you may be excluded from reentering the room at the Escape Room
